hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

scope: Explicit lagging of symmetric AMG during retained linear thermal theta integration

methodology.order: ABBA twice for each physical mesh
methodology.reference: Production CPU ThermalTimeStepper with GMRES+ILU at 1e-12
methodology.scored_window: Four changed-scheme steps per trajectory; first step, preparation and host assembly excluded
methodology.timing: Host wall time through synchronized matrix update and committed solve
methodology.gpu_contention: No compute process reported before the first experiment; repeat ran after all builds and CPU tests finished

failure_contract: Device-copy and native-validation launch failures preserve history and block lagged update/step until full repair
Device finite validation rejects overflow from finite coefficients
Complete refresh repairs failed update; exact scalar subsequent-step gate passes
limits: Opt-in policy; default scheme update still refreshes AMG
Large coefficient changes may increase iteration count or require a fresh hierarchy
Caller must renew effective SPD assumption; fixed mass/stiffness/constraints only
No adaptive error estimator or automatic hierarchy-refresh policy
Measured speedup covers warm update plus solve, not total application startup/assembly
Two physical meshes and one GPU; no universal FEM speedup claim
